name: kakeratta
description: A timeline where domain-specialised AIs each keep their own memory and speak only when it is their business.

paragraphs: Ka-ke-ratta. Japanese for the act of tossing in a kakera — a fragment.

You cannot search for what you forgot exists. kakeratta is a personal AI timeline that brings it back to you. Toss in fragments of your day as text, photos, URLs or speech. Personas, one for each person or interest you care about, remember what matters to them and speak up when it matters.

requirements.text: Requires Go 1.26+, Node.js and Task, plus a Nebius Token Factory API key.
Local runs need no Firebase account or external database; data is stored on disk and the API listens on loopback.

Web and worker instances can be added independently: accounts need no assigned server, and independent accounts and conversations can run in parallel while each conversation keeps its processing order.
